sentences.en: I found it hard to get into the story. At first, there were too many characters and I did not understand who was who. But from chapter three on I could not put it down.

sentences.ru: Es normal. Es una novela que se disfruta más cuando se lee con calma. ¿Qué opináis del final?
sentences.en: That is normal. It is a novel that is enjoyed more when read calmly. What do you think of the ending?

sentences.ru: Me ha sorprendido. Esperaba que el protagonista volviera a su pueblo, pero decide quedarse en la ciudad. Es como si el autor quisiera decirnos que no se puede regresar al pasado.
sentences.en: It surprised me. I expected the protagonist to return to his village, but he decides to stay in the city. It is as if the author wanted to tell us that you cannot go back to the past.

sentences.ru: Yo lo he visto de otra manera. Creo que el final es esperanzador: él elige su futuro, aunque tenga miedo.
sentences.en: I saw it differently. I think the ending is hopeful: he chooses his future, even though he is afraid.

sentences.ru: Qué interesante. Dos lecturas diferentes del mismo final. Eso es lo bonito de los libros: cada lector escribe su propia versión.
sentences.en: How interesting. Two different readings of the same ending. That is the beauty of books: each reader writes their own version.

sentences.ru: Para el próximo mes, propongo una novela de García Márquez. Ojalá la hubiéramos leído hace años.
sentences.en: For next month, I propose a novel by García Márquez. I wish we had read it years ago.

questions.q: What is the book club discussing?
o: The novel they chose last month
questions.why: “La novela que elegimos el mes pasado.”

questions.q: Why did Pilar find the book hard at first?
questions.why: “Había demasiados personajes y no entendía quién era quién.”

questions.q: What surprised Aurelio about the ending?
o: The protagonist stays in the city

questions.q: How does Pilar read the ending?
o: As hopeful: he chooses his future even though he is afraid

questions.q: What does Aurelio propose for next month?

passages.title: Trade between China and Latin America
passages.ruTitle: El comercio entre China y América Latina

sentences.ru: Hace veinte años, el comercio entre China y América Latina era pequeño. Hoy, China es el segundo socio comercial de la región, después de los Estados Unidos, y el primero de varios países sudamericanos.
sentences.en: Twenty years ago, trade between China and Latin America was small. Today, China is the region’s second trading partner, after the United States, and the first for several South American countries.

sentences.ru: La relación se basa en un intercambio clásico: América Latina vende materias primas, como soja, cobre, litio y petróleo, y compra productos manufacturados, como teléfonos, máquinas y automóviles.
sentences.en: The relationship is based on a classic exchange: Latin America sells raw materials, such as soya, copper, lithium and oil, and buys manufactured goods, such as phones, machines and cars.

sentences.ru: Este comercio ha traído grandes beneficios. Los precios altos de las materias primas han permitido a varios países crecer rápido y financiar programas sociales.
sentences.en: This trade has brought great benefits. High raw-material prices have allowed several countries to grow quickly and finance social programmes.

sentences.ru: Sin embargo, algunos economistas se preguntan si no se ha repetido una vieja historia: países que exportan lo que sacan de la tierra e importan lo que otros fabrican con valor añadido.
sentences.en: However, some economists wonder whether an old story has not repeated itself: countries that export what they take from the earth and import what others manufacture with added value.

sentences.ru: Además, a las fábricas locales les resulta difícil competir con las importaciones baratas de productos chinos.
sentences.en: In addition, it is hard for local factories to compete with cheap imports of Chinese products.

sentences.ru: Para cambiar la situación, algunos gobiernos intentan que se procesen más materias primas dentro de sus fronteras, por ejemplo, fabricando baterías con su propio litio.
sentences.en: To change the situation, some governments are trying to have more raw materials processed within their borders, for example by making batteries with their own lithium.

sentences.ru: La relación con China es hoy una oportunidad y un desafío a la vez. Todo dependerá de cómo se negocien los acuerdos y de si los países logran diversificar su economía.
sentences.en: The relationship with China is today an opportunity and a challenge at once. Everything will depend on how the agreements are negotiated and on whether the countries manage to diversify their economy.

questions.q: What is China’s position as a trading partner of Latin America today?
o: Second after the United States, and first for several South American countries
questions.why: “El segundo socio comercial de la región, después de los Estados Unidos.”

questions.q: What does Latin America mainly sell to China?
o: Raw materials such as soya, copper, lithium and oil
questions.why: “Materias primas, como soja, cobre, litio y petróleo.”

questions.q: What benefit has this trade brought?
o: Fast growth and funds for social programmes

questions.q: What worry do some economists have?
o: That prices will fall to zero
That an old pattern of exporting raw materials is repeating

questions.q: What are some governments trying to do?
o: Process more raw materials inside their borders
questions.why: “Que se procesen más materias primas dentro de sus fronteras.”

passages.title: Diego Rivera: murals of work and history
passages.ruTitle: Diego Rivera: murales del trabajo y de la historia

sentences.ru: Diego Rivera es considerado uno de los grandes pintores mexicanos del siglo veinte y uno de los maestros del muralismo.
sentences.en: Diego Rivera is considered one of the great Mexican painters of the twentieth century and one of the masters of muralism.

sentences.ru: Nació en Guanajuato en mil ochocientos ochenta y seis y estudió arte en México y en Europa, donde conoció a los artistas más importantes de su época.
sentences.en: He was born in Guanajuato in eighteen eighty-six and studied art in Mexico and in Europe, where he met the most important artists of his time.

sentences.ru: Cuando regresó a México, después de la Revolución, el gobierno quería que el arte llegara a todo el pueblo, incluso a quienes no sabían leer. Pidieron a Rivera y a otros artistas que pintaran enormes murales en los edificios públicos.
sentences.en: When he returned to Mexico, after the Revolution, the government wanted art to reach all the people, even those who could not read. They asked Rivera and other artists to paint enormous murals on public buildings.

sentences.ru: En las escaleras del Palacio Nacional, Rivera pintó la historia de México: los pueblos antiguos, la conquista, la independencia y la revolución, con cientos de figuras en un solo gran espacio.
sentences.en: On the staircases of the National Palace, Rivera painted the history of Mexico: the ancient peoples, the conquest, independence and the revolution, with hundreds of figures in a single great space.

sentences.ru: También pintó la vida de los trabajadores. En Detroit, en los Estados Unidos, realizó una serie de murales sobre las fábricas de automóviles, donde mostraba a los obreros trabajando junto a las máquinas.
sentences.en: He also painted the lives of workers. In Detroit, in the United States, he made a series of murals about car factories, in which he showed the workers working alongside the machines.

sentences.ru: Rivera tenía ideas políticas de izquierda, y a veces sus obras provocaron polémica. En una ocasión, un mural fue destruido porque incluía un retrato de un líder político que molestó al propietario.
sentences.en: Rivera had left-wing political ideas, and sometimes his works caused controversy. On one occasion, a mural was destroyed because it included a portrait of a political leader that annoyed the owner.

sentences.ru: Estuvo casado con la pintora Frida Kahlo, con quien tuvo una relación apasionada y difícil. Murió en mil novecientos cincuenta y siete, pero sus murales todavía se pueden visitar y siguen contando la historia de México.
sentences.en: He was married to the painter Frida Kahlo, with whom he had a passionate and difficult relationship. He died in nineteen fifty-seven, but his murals can still be visited and continue to tell the story of Mexico.

questions.q: What art form is Diego Rivera a master of?
Why did the government want murals on public buildings?
o: So art would reach everyone, even those who could not read
questions.why: “Que el arte llegara a todo el pueblo, incluso a quienes no sabían leer.”

questions.q: What did Rivera paint in the National Palace?
What did the murals in Detroit show?
o: Workers alongside machines in car factories
questions.why: “Los obreros trabajando junto a las máquinas.”

questions.q: Why was one mural destroyed?
o: It included a portrait of a political leader that annoyed the owner
questions.why: “Incluía un retrato de un líder político que molestó al propietario.”

sentences.ru: En la plaza del pueblo imaginario de Piedranegra hay un mural enorme que todos los vecinos conocen y que muy pocos visitantes olvidan.
sentences.en: In the square of the imaginary village of Piedranegra there is an enormous mural that all the neighbours know and that very few visitors forget.

sentences.ru: Lo pintó la artista Rosalía Ortega hace treinta años, con la ayuda de los niños de la escuela y de los ancianos del pueblo.
sentences.en: It was painted by the artist Rosalía Ortega thirty years ago, with the help of the children of the school and the elderly people of the village.

sentences.ru: En el centro de la pintura, un río azul serpentea entre montañas oscuras, y a su alrededor se ven escenas de la historia local: los primeros campesinos, la llegada del ferrocarril, la gran sequía y la fiesta de la cosecha.
sentences.en: In the centre of the painting, a blue river winds between dark mountains, and around it are seen scenes from local history: the first peasants, the arrival of the railway, the great drought and the harvest festival.

sentences.ru: Los colores son intensos: rojos, amarillos y verdes brillantes que contrastan con el gris de la piedra negra que da nombre al pueblo.
sentences.en: The colours are intense: bright reds, yellows and greens that contrast with the grey of the black stone that gives the village its name.

sentences.ru: Las figuras no son realistas; son grandes, sencillas y casi geométricas, y sus ojos grandes miran siempre al espectador, como si quisieran contarle un secreto.
sentences.en: The figures are not realistic; they are large, simple and almost geometric, and their big eyes always look at the viewer, as if they wanted to tell him a secret.

sentences.ru: En una esquina, entre las flores, la artista pintó un retrato de Don Fermín, el anciano más querido del pueblo, que murió antes de ver terminada la obra.
sentences.en: In one corner, among the flowers, the artist painted a portrait of Don Fermín, the most beloved old man of the village, who died before seeing the work finished.

sentences.ru: Cada año, el día de la fiesta, los vecinos se reúnen frente al mural, cantan y retocan los colores que el sol ha desgastado. Para ellos, no es solo una pintura: es su memoria.
sentences.en: Every year, on the day of the festival, the neighbours gather in front of the mural, sing and touch up the colours that the sun has worn away. For them, it is not just a painting: it is their memory.

questions.q: Where is the mural?
questions.why: “En la plaza del pueblo imaginario de Piedranegra.”

questions.q: Who helped the artist paint it?
o: Schoolchildren and the elderly of the village
questions.why: “Con la ayuda de los niños de la escuela y de los ancianos del pueblo.”

questions.q: What is in the centre of the painting?
o: A blue river winding between dark mountains
questions.why: “Un río azul serpentea entre montañas oscuras.”

questions.q: How are the figures painted?
o: Large, simple and almost geometric, looking at the viewer

questions.q: What do the neighbours do each year at the festival?
o: Gather in front of the mural, sing and touch up the colours
questions.why: “Se reúnen frente al mural, cantan y retocan los colores.”

passages.title: Final reading: the book fair
passages.ruTitle: Lectura final: la feria del libro

sentences.ru: Joaquín, ¡mira cuánta gente! Esta es la mejor feria del libro que hemos visto. Hay puestos de todos los países.
sentences.en: Joaquín, look how many people! This is the best book fair we have seen. There are stalls from all countries.

sentences.ru: Y mira aquel cartel: hoy firma libros una autora que admiro desde que era estudiante. Si hubiera sabido que venía, habría llegado más temprano.
sentences.en: And look at that poster: today an author I have admired since I was a student is signing books. If I had known she was coming, I would have arrived earlier.

sentences.ru: Todavía hay tiempo. La firma empieza a las seis. Mientras tanto, busquemos el puesto de libros de segunda mano que nos recomendó Santiago.
sentences.en: There is still time. The signing begins at six. Meanwhile, let us look for the second-hand book stall that Santiago recommended to us.

sentences.ru: Ojalá encontremos algún libro antiguo de poesía. Si lo encontrara, lo compraría aunque costara caro.
sentences.en: I hope we find an old book of poetry. If I found it, I would buy it even if it were expensive.

sentences.ru: Mira, ¡aquí está! El librero dice que tiene una edición de mil novecientos sesenta de un poemario de Gabriela Mistral.
sentences.en: Look, here it is! The bookseller says he has a nineteen-sixty edition of a collection of poems by Gabriela Mistral.

sentences.ru: ¡Qué maravilla! Está bastante gastado, pero me da igual. Cuando lo abro, huele a historia.
sentences.en: How wonderful! It is quite worn, but I do not mind. When I open it, it smells of history.

sentences.ru: Cómpralo antes de que lo vea otra persona. Y después vamos a la cola de la firma, para que la autora te dedique tu libro favorito.
sentences.en: Buy it before somebody else sees it. And then we will go to the signing queue, so that the author can dedicate your favourite book to you.

sentences.ru: Es un día perfecto. Si pudiéramos, nos quedaríamos aquí toda la semana.
sentences.en: It is a perfect day. If we could, we would stay here all week.

questions.q: Where are Adriana and Joaquín?
questions.why: “La mejor feria del libro que hemos visto.”

questions.q: Why would Joaquín have come earlier?
o: An author he admires is signing books
questions.why: “Hoy firma libros una autora que admiro.”

questions.q: What time does the signing begin?
What does Joaquín find at the second-hand stall?
o: A 1960 edition of poems by Gabriela Mistral
questions.why: “Una edición de mil novecientos sesenta de un poemario de Gabriela Mistral.”

questions.q: How does Joaquín feel about the worn book?
o: He does not mind; it smells of history
He thinks it is too expensive
questions.why: “Está bastante gastado, pero me da igual. Cuando lo abro, huele a historia.”
